caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed wine glass positioned upright at the center of the composition. The image is rendered in shades of gray, indicating the use of graphite pencil or similar medium on a light beige background. The wine glass features a wide bowl that gradually narrows towards the bottom and sits atop a solid stem with a round, stable base. The bowl of the glass is decorated with an engraved or etched pattern, showing a large flower with multiple petals and several long, pointed leaves encircling the glass. The stem has a bulbous shape in the center, tapering at both ends, and shows subtle shading to suggest transparency and texture. The circular foot is drawn with shading to convey its thickness and reflective quality, and subtle shadowing below the base gives a slight sense of depth. The artist's name, "John Dana," is written in small letters in the lower left corner of the page.
title: Goblet
